# Keshavarz20 (کشاورز بیست)

> Keshavarz20 is a Persian-language agricultural ecommerce and knowledge resource focused on irrigation equipment, agricultural inputs, seedlings, technical guides, calculators, agricultural news, and practical Q&A.

## Canonical website
- https://keshavarz20.com/

## Main resources
- Shop: https://keshavarz20.com/shop/
- Agricultural news: https://keshavarz20.com/news/
- Practical Q&A: https://keshavarz20.com/question/
- Education and guides: https://keshavarz20.com/بخش-آموزش/
- About Keshavarz20: https://keshavarz20.com/درباره-ما/
- XML sitemap: https://keshavarz20.com/sitemap_index.xml

## Core topics
- Drip and sprinkler irrigation systems
- Polyethylene pipe
